abstract: Serum levels of etoposide obtained 5 min after administration of 100 mg/m2 were between 11 and 30 micrograms/ml. By 24 h after drug administration, serum levels had fallen to between 0.19 and 1.11 micrograms/ml. Interpatient variation of etoposide serum concentrations obtained 5 min after drug administration was low, whereas interpatient variation 24 h later was noticeably higher. A significant correlation was observed (r = -0.698) between the WBC nadir and the mean etoposide serum concentrations, measured 24 h after drug administration, in patients receiving etoposide in combination with cyclophosphamide and actinomycin D. However, a relationship was not observed in those patients receiving etoposide alone. There was no observed difference in the efficacy or toxicity of 500 mg/m2 etoposide when the dose was administered either as 100 mg/m2 on each of 5 consecutive days or as 250 mg/m2 on days 1 and 3. There was no significant difference between AUC values calculated from etoposide concentration versus time profiles in patients receiving the drug on days 1 and 3 and those values obtained with the 5-day schedule. Patients resistant to a conventional dose of etoposide were given a higher dose of 1 g/m2/24 h, but this schedule did not cause an increase in efficacy despite an increase in serum levels of the drug. CSF levels in two of these patients receiving high-dose etoposide were 1.28% and 2.09% of the serum concentrations.
abstract_ja: 100 mg/m2投与後5分の血清エトポシド濃度は11〜30 μg/mlであった。投与24時間後には血清濃度が0.19〜1.11 μg/mlまで低下した。投与5分後の血清濃度の患者間変動は小さかったが、24時間後の患者間変動は明らかに大きかった。シクロホスファミドおよびアクチノマイシンDと併用した患者では、白血球最低値と投与24時間後の平均エトポシド血清濃度の間に有意な相関が認められた(r = -0.698)。しかし、エトポシド単独投与の患者では、この関係は認められなかった。500 mg/m2のエトポシドを100 mg/m2ずつ5日間連続で投与した場合と、250 mg/m2を1日目と3日目に投与した場合とで、有効性や毒性に差は認められなかった。これら2つの投与法で算出したAUCの間にも有意差はなかった。従来量に抵抗性を示した患者には、1 g/m2/24時間の高用量が投与されたが、血清濃度は上昇したにもかかわらず有効性は向上しなかった。この高用量エトポシドを投与された患者のうち2例では、髄液中濃度が血清濃度の1.28%および2.09%であった。
